notes: A=content; B adds reachability/history; C adds inferred lineage; D adds propagation; E adds deletion/removal evidence.
All ablations share detector and object scope. Detection counts may be identical; ranking/relationship metrics measure added value.
Shared graph/snapshot/lifecycle infrastructure is retained in all models. These are component/score ablations, not optimized standalone scanner speed comparisons.
Budgets constrain detection reads before lineage; structural traversal still visits all acquired objects.
Memory is peak traced Python allocations, excludes Git subprocess/native memory. Profiling overhead is included in all timings.
Bootstrap intervals describe repeated timings on this machine; they do not establish generalization or statistical superiority.
Externally supplied labels must be independently verified. Synthetic results do not establish real-world ranking quality.
